name: Slideshow Zoom Fade
description: Full-screen image slideshow driven by wheel, touch drag, or arrow buttons. The current slide shrinks away while the next slides in from below with an inner zoom and parallax.
contents: Hint text with previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch, and pointer drag move to the next or previous slide through GSAP Observer
Outgoing slide scales down while its image zooms in, incoming slide slides up from below with inner parallax
Slides loop endlessly and input is locked during a transition
Container stays hidden until GSAP loads and images preload
editableByProps: Images, background and text colors, hint text
Transition durations, eases, scales, parallax, wheel sensitivity
Navigation button visibility, size, and colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change arrow glyphs on the buttons
needsCodeEdit.where: ← and → buttons in the showNavButtons block

fixed: Wheel, touch, and pointer input on the slideshow is captured for navigation
